name: rosetta-concurrent-computing
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use Ghul.Coroutines

let random = System.Random(42)

say(word: string) -> COROUTINE is
    for _ in 1::random.next(1, 5) do
        await pause()
    od

    write_line(word)
si

for word in ["Enjoy", "Rosetta", "Code"] do
    say(word)
od

run()
